description: For individuals of all ages, Harry's Water Park offers a wide range of enjoyable activities. Paddle and pedal boats, kayaking, fishing, wildlife, nature walks, swimming pools with water slides, outdoor grilling shelters, a children's play area, a well-stocked bar and food court, guest rooms, log cabins, and a host of other exciting activities are among the special features. Listed opening hours: Waterpark: 9am - 6pm everyday. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
